full_title: Wall of Eyes by The Smile
name: Wall of Eyes
description_preview:
Wall of Eyes is the second album by The Smile.

Following the resounding success of their celebrated debut album, A Light for Attracting Attention, in 2022, The Smile embarked on an tour, captivating audiences with not only the tracks from their first album but also unveiling unreleased songs. Amid these live performances, Thom Yorke confirmed that the band’s second album was already in the making.

On June 20, 2023, The Smile gave the world a taste of what’s to come with the release of the studio version of “Bending Hectic”, Wall of Eyes' first single. Later, in December, the second segment of The Crow Flies exhibition was hosted at London’s TIN MAN ART gallery, which featured a collection of paintings co-created by Stanley Donwood and Thom Yorke, including the original painting for Wall of Eyes' album cover.

Eventually, the trio officially announced their second album, on November 13, 2023, along with the title track and music video directed by Paul Thomas Anderson.

body.plain:
The album artwork for The Smile’s second release, Wall of Eyes, furthers the artistic collaboration seen in the artwork of their debut album, A Light for Attracting Attention. Crafted as a painting with the same title, this cover is a joint effort by Stanley Donwood and Thom Yorke. Notably, the artwork is featured in the duo’s exhibition at London’s TIN MAN ART named “The Crow Flies,” a collection born out of creative sessions that took place concurrently with the album recording.



 Wall of Eyes (2023) by Stanley Donwood & Thom Yorke

body.plain:
The artwork for the “Bending Hectic” features a painting by Thom Yorke and Stanley Donwood on Awagami paper and linen using gouache. This piece is titled River Spikes.

The winding paths depicted in the painting are reminiscent of the bending roads mentioned in “Bending Hectic”’s lyrics.
